acceptance: Reproduce by forcing container detection (e.g. monkeypatching the detector) and show the failure; the tests then pin container detection explicitly so they pass on any host.
A test covers both container and non-container variant ids for at least one platform.
context: Evidence: SaltAutoCore report, 2026-11-01 (not reproduced by the parent).
description: During #3878, `make pr-preflight` on the agent's host failed 12 tests in tests/unit/platforms/test_deployment_modes_recorded.py because the computed published_variant_id gained the `^container` suffix (added by #3618 for runs inside a container). CI passed the same tests. The tests read real host container detection instead of fixing it, so their result depends on where they run.
